headline: Browser-based live avatar camera for OBS, no mocap rig needed
summary: Experiment with a new pipeline for live avatars in streams and video calls, with a free tier to test the OBS virtual camera setup.
details: A developer has shared a method for integrating live avatars into streams and video calls without the need for expensive motion capture equipment. This approach utilizes a browser-based live avatar camera.

The pipeline is designed to work with OBS (Open Broadcaster Software) and offers a free tier with 30 credits for users to test the virtual camera setup. This allows for experimentation with different latency and quality trade-offs.

The project, named LiveSwap, aims to make live avatar technology more accessible for streamers and content creators. The developer is actively seeking feedback on which performance aspects are most critical for users.

topic: Cursor coding agent adds voice chat
headline_marked: Cursor launches [[real-time voice chat]] with AI coding agents
headline: Cursor launches real-time voice chat with AI coding agents
summary: Talk to your AI coding assistant and hear it talk back in real-time, with progress notes and spoken summaries of its work.
details: Cursor officially launched its Voice Chat feature for AI coding agents on November 6, 2026. This new functionality allows users to engage in real-time, two-way spoken conversations with their coding assistants directly within the Cursor IDE, web interface, and iOS app.

Users can describe code changes aloud, ask questions about the agent's progress, and receive spoken updates as the agent works. The agent also provides brief spoken summaries upon task completion, with detailed responses remaining in the chat for review.

The voice capabilities are powered by Grok Voice, offering several voice options like Ara, Eve, Leo, Rex, and Sal. For enhanced privacy, a 'Privacy Mode' ensures zero data retention during voice chats, though the underlying coding model remains user-selected.

A dedicated waveform button initiates voice chat, replacing the standard send button when the agent is idle. On iOS, hands-free operation is possible via "Hey Siri, call Cursor," with Lock Screen and Dynamic Island controls expected in future updates.

Cursor distinguishes this feature from simple dictation, which converts speech to text. Voice Chat is a conversational interface where the agent actively responds aloud, facilitating a more natural interaction for users who think or code away from the keyboard.

The company acknowledges limitations, noting that spoken summaries are intentionally lossy and may not suit users who prefer reading every detail. Additionally, using voice chat in shared workspaces presents social considerations.

This launch follows Cursor's recent 'Build Live Apps' feature, signaling a strategic shift towards conversational and background-running interfaces for coding agents. Cursor is betting on voice as the next primary interaction method for AI development tools.
